# Rule 4 - DO Self-antag
You can self antag, just don't be part of security, command or mindshielded. Everything else is (pretty much) free reign, just don't cause some XK-Class end of the world scenario by spawning 800 nukes
## Precedents
- Don't round remove people as a non-antagonist. (VERY FUCKING IMPORTANT!!!!! NO RR AS SELF ANTAG!!!) - Don't sabotage the station as a non-antagonist. Vandalizing the front of security is fine, smashing their windows and doors is not. - Silicons following their laws are not self-antagging, but can be punished for excessive leaps of logic to perform self-antag-like actions.
